name: TAB-71 / Romanian TAB family
protection: Light welded armour, amphibious. Game: immune to 5.56/5.45/7.62x39/7.62x51; 7.62x54R and larger can penetrate side/rear and disable wheels, engine and optics; every launcher in the game list penetrates.
visual_notes: BTR-60 style boat-shaped 8x8 hull with four evenly spaced axles and a sharp nose
Small conical one-man MG turret on the front half of the roof
Horizontal exhaust pipes at the rear; TAB-71M has a small side hatch between the 2nd and 3rd axles
TAB-77 follows the BTR-70 shape; B33 Zimbru the BTR-80 (side doors between axles 2 and 3)
